title: Count tile headlines are larger than KPI tile headlines
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Compare the size of the Sales by Customer headline (e.g. 69 customers) and the At Risk Customers headline (e.g. 1) with the Revenue headline (e.g. $2,422.00).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Both count headlines are printed in visibly larger text than the four KPI headlines.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12. Split out of C88626. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 01_Opens_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R4: “The count tiles show their headline count in a larger size than the KPI tiles' headline.”
